autodetect.bypassx_note: [Wayland] BypassX is on: the daemon cannot see a layout change it did not make itself, so the parser refuses Enabled = true while that flag stays on. Clear it on the Basics tab first.
autodetect.enabled_label: Retype a word that was finished in the wrong layout
autodetect.languages_hint: Languages holds one entry per line as "<group>:<language>", where group is the 0-based XKB group to switch to and language is one of: {{.Value}}. MinChars is the shortest run of letters worth judging and Confidence the margin between the two best readings the daemon must see before it touches the keyboard.
autodetect.no_group_named: The form names no group for {{.Layout}}: add it to Languages before applying.
autodetect.no_readings:
Buffer: "{{.Buffer}}"

The daemon sent no readings: [AutoDetect] is switched off in the running config or names one language. Enable it, Apply, then preview again.
autodetect.no_verdict: No verdict: this run fits neither reading, so the daemon leaves it alone.
autodetect.not_corrected_confidence: Would NOT be corrected: {{.Confidence}} is below Confidence {{.Threshold}}.
autodetect.not_corrected_group: Would NOT be corrected: the word was typed in group {{.N}}, which Languages does not name.
autodetect.not_corrected_min_chars: Would NOT be corrected: {{.Count}} letters is below MinChars {{.MinChars}}.
autodetect.nothing_to_do: Nothing to do: the winning group {{.N}} is already the group the word was typed in.
autodetect.preview_hint: The daemon judges a word when it is completed; the preview judges the whole buffer as it stands, so a buffer that already holds the first keys of the next word is scored one word longer here. The daemon also refuses a word while a compose sequence is in progress and skips the one word right after a layout you switched by hand; neither state is in the status, so the preview cannot show those refusals.
autodetect.would_correct: WOULD be corrected to {{.Layout}}: group {{.Group}} instead of {{.WordGroup}}.
